source.manifestDefinition: Sorted Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, tools/native-codex/queue.patch and crates/tools .rs/.toml/.mjs/.json/.cjs/.ts excluding target/node_modules/*.validation.json/validation-*.json; aggregate SHA256(path NUL per-file SHA256 newline)

behavior.account: Existing launch binding, or deepest unique transcript-root ownership; unknown/ambiguous ownership is shown as 계정 미확인, never guessed from a default. Arbitrary account display labels, not an authentication attestation. Existing lower pane border in split/zoom; whole-grapheme truncation and control/bidi sanitization.
behavior.f6: New running sessions start OFF. F6 toggles ON until another F6, across edits, paste, submission and queue drain. Enter snapshots the mode onto the actual UserMessage identity; later F6 never rewrites accepted/queued messages. OFF preserves incoming native model/effort and bypasses Jev.
behavior.ownership: Same-thread reconnect/input restoration retains the session mode, including empty drafts. New chat/fork identity starts OFF. No disk persistence, cross-session consent inheritance or old-pane hot patch.
behavior.f7: Removed native Jev preview UI/RPC and Node preview-token lifecycle. Retired local RPC is rejected locally, never forwarded to the backend. Native key forwarding remains ordinary.
behavior.unchanged: Native Enter/queue, shell, approvals, Escape, Ctrl-G/Trace, Ctrl-Q hide; authentication/accounts, global CLIs/settings/plugins, dependencies and desktop app.

firstActualNativeRun.observation: 44/45 fixtures observed at 100ms; all observed PIDs/ports/roots gone. Final GREEN read-only observer uses 25ms and observes all 45 without weakening expected count.

preservedRedAndRepairs.projector: Actual vendored Rust vt100 independently showed Jev ON in both retained late-ACK captures while the test-only projection omitted the row. Three ESC M regressions captured 7/10 RED; three scrolling-margin regressions captured 10/13 RED. Minimal ESC M + CSI r + bounded line-feed fix gives 13/13 GREEN and restores the exact ON label on retained actual ANSI. No production/native behavior changed for this harness repair.
preservedRedAndRepairs.retry: New retry test matched an identical history row as if a new typed composer draft had rendered, allowing Enter to join an unflushed typing burst. Uses existing real bracketed-paste PTY boundary for explicit retry, retaining every identity/cancellation/ON/late-result/no-replay assertion; no artificial positive sleep or RPC injection.
preservedRedAndRepairs.invocationCorrection: An attempted --lib Rust test command failed before running tests because mindplayer-tui is a binary-only package. Corrected --bin mindplayer run passed all 10 scoped tests.

changedFiles.note: Task scope, not attribution of every inherited dirty file. The native patch includes prior native routing/queue changes; do not revert unrelated work.

remainingRisksAndGaps: No live Jev/OpenAI/Claude provider inference, account login or OAuth validation was requested/performed; tests use isolated synthetic backends/judges.
Text-cell evidence does not establish original terminal styling, pixel fidelity, arbitrary terminal themes or IME behavior.
Private native CLI is a pinned dev-small local verification build; Code Mode host is official prebuilt, not same-source attested.
No whole-workspace/ambient-HOME app unit run, native dependency-inclusive Clippy, commit, push, release publication, global CLI/plugin/settings or desktop change.
